source.title: 30 éves a Bécsi Magyar Iskola
source.scope: school history, pedagogy, teachers, programs and community up to the 30th anniversary

institutionalEducationClaims.claim: The primary educational goal is developing the spoken and written Hungarian language use of children and young people with Hungarian heritage-language backgrounds, together with Hungarian literature, history and culture.

The school explicitly described its staff as qualified preschool educators, primary teachers and teachers working under a shared pedagogical concept, using differentiated instruction and taking bilingualism research into account.
The school treated community formation as integral to education, linking pupils and parents through celebrations, excursions, performances, competitions and shared cultural life.

historicalContinuity.publicationClaim: The founders resumed Hungarian mother-tongue education for children from elementary level through secondary-school age in Vienna in the late 1980s.
historicalContinuity.canonicalFoundingRule: Use 1987-09 as the canonical BMI start. The same jubilee publication contains a later narrative sentence saying 1988; this is treated as an internal historical inconsistency because another section of the publication explicitly states that Dr. Hegedűs János and Ilona successfully started the school in September 1987, consistent with stronger external corroboration.

communityContinuity.claim: The publication describes growth in pupil numbers, expansion of the teacher group and the formation of a real school community around the Schwedenplatz location, with parents increasingly joining school events.

safetyRules.sourceScope: Treat roles and qualifications as historically documented at the publication date unless separately confirmed as current.
safetyRules.employment: Do not infer employment or payroll status from teaching or leadership mentions.
safetyRules.nameNormalization: Preserve historical spellings from the publication unless a verified current identity source establishes a normalized form.
safetyRules.quality: Use evidence-based descriptors such as qualified, experienced, academically supported, pedagogically diverse and long-serving; avoid unsupported comparative superlatives.
